Use case: stylized-concept. A production single-object cutout sprite for a FIXED ORTHOGRAPHIC medieval western-fantasy pixel-art game courtyard. Reference image is STYLE ONLY; do not draw its house. Hand-painted crisp pixel clusters, restrained warm earthy highlights, muted cool olive shadows, tasteful chunky shapes, irregular silhouette, NO photorealism, no smooth CGI, no noisy micro-detail. Camera looks down at 35 degrees, azimuth 25 degrees, orthographic no vanishing points, see top, broad front and narrower right side. Lighting painted from upper left. Tree much wider than its trunk, approximately 5 meters tall. No spherical or conical canopy; irregular hand-drawn contours and clearly designed masses. Portrait or square transparent sprite.

prompts.meadow: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE seamless top-down ground texture tile for a medieval hand-painted pixel-art game courtyard. Entire square filled edge-to-edge with muted olive and sage green meadow grass. Designed large quiet color clusters of interlocking grass patches, gently uneven earthy mossy tones, occasional tiny dry blades. LOW contrast, low visual noise, ground stays quieter and darker than characters and props. No flowers, no rocks, no paths, no objects, no lighting gradient, no perspective, NO transparency, no borders, no text, no checkerboard. Painterly crisp pixel-art clusters suitable for offline reduction to a 192x192 tile spanning 8m; avoid photorealistic blades or computer generated noisy stipple. Harmonize with the supplied cottage's moss and warm stone.
